jobs.title: Audio Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Senior Software EngineerAbout the Job** 

We are seeking a highly motivated individual for a software development position focused on developing audio applications and plug\-ins for sound designers, musicians and audio production professionals. No two days are alike at iZotope/Boris FX and we thrive on it \- we transform our passion for audio into innovations in the way we create and listen to sound.

The team is fully remote and highly collaborative, has a passion for high\-quality code and in learning how to continually improve our craft. Qualified applicants should have in\-depth knowledge and demonstrable experience designing, developing and debugging software in C/C\+\+ for Mac and Windows. The ideal candidate would have a passion for music and audio technology \- though prior experience with audio plugins or the audio industry is not required.

Responsibilities will include:

* Work closely with a cross\-functional agile team consisting of Product Management, UX Designers, Sound Designers, Research and QA to define and realize product requirements
* Design, prototype, develop and deliver new audio products in C/C\+\+
* Maintain and upgrade existing audio products written in C/C\+\+
* Contribute to improvements, refactoring and re\-architecture of the application and UI framework, to maintain state\-of\-the art foundation for our products

Required Qualifications:

* 5 or more years of experience developing efficient, reusable and reliable C/C\+\+ code for production\-quality products
* Excellent English language verbal and written communication skills
* BS in Computer Science or equivalent combination of technical education and work experience
* Exceptional engineering skills, designs for quality, expert problem solver, strong analytical skills
* Solid understanding of test\-driven development, design patterns, software frameworks, performance optimization, system architecture
* Self\-directed, detail\-oriented, able to learn new technologies and work independently
* Experience as a technical leader and/or coach to other software developers
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Team player and able to work collaboratively with peer Software Engineers, QA, Product Managers, UX Designers, Sound Designers

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience with cross\-platform development using Microsoft Visual Studio, Apple Xcode, Git
* Familiarity with continuous integration environment and tools
* Experience with Agile or Scrum software development methodologies
* Experience using and/or developing audio plugin SDKs a plus
* Working knowledge or exposure to DSP and audio signal processing algorithms a plus
* Working knowledge or exposure to Python \& Python tools for scientific computing and machine learning
* Experience developing and deploying services, web applications or cloud solutions using AWS

**About iZotope** 

iZotope makes audio products and technologies that are used around the world. We have

a wide range of customers, from the millions of consumers who enjoy our audio

enhancement to GRAMMY\-winning producers using our pro products to the corporations

who license our technology for use in their own products. We are a growing team of

highly motivated people who are constantly looking to innovate and improve the way we

create and listen to audio.

iZotope is part of Boris FX \- a multinational virtual software company focused on the world\-wide Media and Entertainment industry.

Pay: $51\.39 \- $61\.89 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote
